description: The files a run sealed: the parquet, the column profile, the receipt, the preview. Works on a running, succeeded or failed run — a failed run's partial output is listed too. Example: {"run_id": "…"}. Returns {artifacts: [{artifact_id, kind, size_bytes, digest, media_type}], more}. Bytes are never streamed through this server. Next: get_artifact_download for a URL to fetch yourself.
name: run_artifacts
title: List what a run produced
